All aspects of this file conform to standard AUR packaging practices. The source is pinned to a specific version tag, and the checksum is provided, which enhances reproducibility and security. No network operations, file manipulations, or system modifications are defined in this file. As such, there is no evidence of malicious behavior or supply chain risks.
